Name: Cuter Penny Sprite for Stardewvalley Anime Mods
Author: Kuanxi
Description:
Re-sprited Penny to look like what she looks like in OhoDavi's anime portraits mod.

The previous Penny sprite mods looked really good but I was kind of disappointed that they did not have the beach sprites so this mod comes with literally everything (even Xtardew Valley).

If you want the Xtardew Valley sprite pack, you have to download it separately with the main pack.

New Ver: I redid her bun and redid eye coloring. I made the left part of the hair hang down on specific parts and some beach parts (to convey more emotion), Added some other quality of life stuff, etc

HOW TO INSTALL

- Drag Penny.xnb & Penny_Beach.xnb into Steam Library -> Steam Apps -> Stardew Valley -> Content -> Characters. Then, replace the two penny files. 

HOW TO INSTALL XTARDEW SPRITE PACK

- - Drag Penny.xnb & Penny_Beach.xnb into Steam Library -> Steam Apps -> Stardew Valley -> Mods -> Xtardew Valley Characters&Sprites -> SpriteNonNude. Then, replace the two penny files.

Have fun :)
